_comment: Maps screenshot file-name room names (no spaces, any case) to room ids in public/data/rooms.json when they don't match automatically. Use null to skip a name. NAME-SECRETS (e.g. WATERFALL-2) only applies to capture-mod shots with that secret count, for server worlds sharing a name. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. Check with: npm run check-rooms -- "<server>/polar_worlds"
_server: Route-recorder server worlds (polar_worlds) named differently from rooms.json
_serverSkipped: Server worlds that aren't quiz rooms
_serverUnknown: Server worlds whose room isn't known yet, left out of the game. Possible matches: Criss-Cross, Rare Carpets, Rare Pillars, Three Floors, Vinny 8 Ball (1 secret); Old Trap / New Trap
_quizRoomsWithoutServerWorld: rooms.json (Odin) rooms with no world on the server. Name (id, secrets, shape, type)
